prompt:
Generate exactly ONE finished image.
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: opaque, full-bleed portrait xianxia game background. Target 941x1672 pixels or nearest supported portrait size with approximately 9:16 aspect ratio.
Primary request: NEW location, "Kiem Trung", an ancient SWORD TOMB VALLEY seen from a high vantage at dusk.
Rendering quality reference only: the supplied jade-palace image. Match its richly detailed painterly semi-realistic fantasy game environment quality, polished materials, atmospheric depth and portrait format. Design a completely new location without the palace architecture, jade columns, reflective jade floor or cherry blossoms of the reference.
Scene: A vast valley between steep, layered stone mountains receding into misty distance. At least FOUR clearly distinguishable depth layers: detailed foreground stone plaza and nearby sword-covered rock edges, middle-distance rugged ridges, more distant overlapping mountains, and faint far mountains disappearing into horizon haze. Countless ancient swords of many sizes planted POINT-DOWN into mountainsides, ridges and valley floor, creating a forest of hilts and upright cold-steel blades. Dense and individually legible near the outer foreground and side ridges, thinning to tiny silhouettes far away. A few colossal BROKEN swords as tall as cliffs stand in the distance.
Composition: elevated viewpoint looking across and down into the vast valley, epic environmental scale. Lower third is a flat weathered slate stone plaza with a single EMPTY circular stone platform centered horizontally, sized for a character to stand on. Preserve a quiet, relatively uncluttered, darker central character silhouette zone across the horizontal middle from 45% to 85% of image height. Frame the open central area with sword-bearing rocky terrain toward the sides; keep swords and debris out of the platform and central standing area. The platform must be clearly visible, solid, flat, and integrated naturally into the weathered plaza.
Sky: deep violet-indigo dusk, thin streaky clouds, narrow warm amber light band along the horizon. No sun disk in the centre.
Palette: indigo, slate blue, cold steel, with restrained amber-gold horizon accents. Atmospheric mist separates every mountain depth layer. Subtle dusk edge light reveals sword shapes without brightening the central character zone excessively. Detailed stone texture, aged sword metal, monumental solemn atmosphere, coherent perspective.
Constraints: no characters, no creatures, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark, no border. Opaque full-bleed background.
